edit.cashNote: If the cash already recorded still covers the new total, its change is worked out again. If not, the sale is recorded as paid exactly.

edit.needsItem: An order needs at least one item.
edit.discountInvalid: Enter the discount as a number.

posSettings.heading: POS Settings
posSettings.intro: Settings the register uses, shared with its own Settings tab - a change made in either place applies to both. The register picks up changes from here at startup, at login, and when Refresh menu is tapped.
posSettings.notConfigured: Not set up yet. The register's own settings are uploaded the first time a manager or admin logs in on it - or save a section here to set it for the register instead.

store.heading: Store name & details
store.hint: Shown on the register's header, receipts and customer display. Everything is optional.
store.name: Store name
store.namePlaceholder: Leave empty to use the default title
store.invalidPhone: Enter a phone number with at least 6 digits.
store.invalidSocial: Enter the page name, handle or link.

payments.heading: Payments
payments.methodsHint: Offered at checkout. At least one must stay on.
payments.invalidUsd: Enter a dollar amount, to the cent.
payments.invalidRiel: Enter riel in whole hundreds, e.g. 5000.

language.heading: Language
language.hint: Used on the register's screens, receipts and customer display. Changing it on the register (in Settings or on the login screen) changes it here too.
language.unset: Not set here yet - the register keeps its own choice and uploads it the next time a manager or admin logs in on it.

menu.heading: Unavailable items
menu.hint: Items switched off as unavailable on the Menu page. Show them greyed out as sold out, so cashiers can tell customers, or hide them to keep the register's menu short. Changing it on the register changes it here too.
menu.unset: Not set here yet - the register keeps its own choice and uploads it the next time a manager or admin logs in on it.

khqr.heading: KHQR banks
khqr.hint: Banks the shop takes Mobile Pay through. The cashier picks one at checkout and the customer screen shows its QR. Changes save immediately.
